sectors.name: Pit straight, T1/T2 and avenue
sectors.observed_environment: Long covered temporary stand opposite the tiered pit/hospitality bar. Narrow grass verges, close concrete walls and high catch fence; mature avenue broadleaf trees beyond. Yellow wall panels; green/yellow kerbs.
sectors.placement_confidence: Sector-level reconstruction; boundaries and depths inferred, not measured from video.

sectors.name: T3–T5 park corners
sectors.observed_environment: Parkland slow corners with low pavilion/service roofs, temporary spectator banks and trees. Green painted apex margins and yellow/green segmented kerbs; no continuous gravel belt.
sectors.placement_confidence: Sector-level reconstruction; boundaries and depths inferred, not measured from video.

sectors.name: Lakeside sweeps
sectors.observed_environment: Lake on the inside of the park loop, palms mixed with mature broadleaf trees, open grass. Distant St Kilda Road apartment silhouettes behind park; blue track walls, painted green edge strips.
sectors.placement_confidence: Sector-level reconstruction; boundaries and depths inferred, not measured from video.

sectors.name: Fast new T9/T10 sequence
sectors.observed_environment: Long fast road framed by catch fencing and park vegetation, temporary white bridges and low race structures. Preserve new flowing sequence, narrow verge and openings toward the lake.
sectors.placement_confidence: Sector-level reconstruction; boundaries and depths inferred, not measured from video.

sectors.name: T11–T14 final corners
sectors.observed_environment: Dense mature tree corridor, blue/yellow wall runs, temporary white hospitality canopies behind fence. Short corner-specific painted exits rather than broad generic runoff.
sectors.placement_confidence: Sector-level reconstruction; boundaries and depths inferred, not measured from video.

sectors.name: Return to pits
sectors.observed_environment: Grandstand and white curved hospitality roofs return; main-straight flags, open pit roof volumes and continuous close safety walls.
sectors.placement_confidence: Sector-level reconstruction; boundaries and depths inferred, not measured from video.
